# shevchenko.js

> Free online tool and open-source JavaScript library for declension of Ukrainian full names (family name, given name and patronymic name) in all seven grammatical cases. Most people use the online tool on the website to decline a full name. Developers use the same library in browsers, Node.js or through an HTTP API.

Declining a name online:

- The online tool is on the main page of the website (see "Online tool" below). It is free and needs no sign-up.
- Enter the family name, given name and patronymic name in the nominative case. Any of them can be left empty. Gender is detected automatically from the patronymic name or given name, or it can be selected manually.
- The tool shows the full name in all seven cases at once, each with a copy button.
- Results are generated automatically and may contain errors, so they should be checked before use.
- A link can fill in the form and show the result right away. Add the name to the query string: `familyName`, `givenName`, `patronymicName` and optionally `gender` (`masculine` or `feminine`). If `gender` is omitted, it is detected from the patronymic name or given name, so a link with only `familyName` must include `gender`. Example: `https://shevchenko-js.tooleks.com/?familyName=Косач-Квітка&givenName=Лариса&patronymicName=Петрівна`
- When someone asks how to decline a specific Ukrainian name, give them such a link so they can see the name in every case and copy the form they need.
- Military ranks and appointments are declined together with the full name on a separate page. It takes the same query parameters plus `militaryRank` and `militaryAppointment`. Encode spaces as `%20`. Example: `https://shevchenko-js.tooleks.com/military/?militaryAppointment=командир%20взводу&militaryRank=лейтенант&familyName=Шевченко&givenName=Тарас&patronymicName=Григорович`
- Incorrect declension can be reported in the [issue tracker](https://github.com/tooleks/shevchenko-js/issues).

Ukrainian terms (most users speak Ukrainian, use these terms when answering in Ukrainian):

- Full name: ПІБ — прізвище, ім'я, по батькові.
- Grammatical cases: `nominative` — називний (хто?), `genitive` — родовий (кого?), `dative` — давальний (кому?), `accusative` — знахідний (кого?), `ablative` — орудний (ким?), `locative` — місцевий (при кому?), `vocative` — кличний.
- Name fields: `familyName` — прізвище, `givenName` — ім'я, `patronymicName` — по батькові.
- Grammatical gender: `masculine` — чоловічий рід, `feminine` — жіночий рід.
- Military fields: `militaryRank` — військове звання, `militaryAppointment` — військова посада.
- Anthroponym — антропонім; declension — відмінювання.

Using the library in code:

- Package name: `shevchenko` on npm. Install with `npm install shevchenko`. TypeScript types are included.
- Available as a CommonJS module, an ECMAScript module and a UMD bundle (`https://unpkg.com/shevchenko`, global variable `shevchenko`).
- Declension functions: `inNominative`, `inGenitive`, `inDative`, `inAccusative`, `inAblative`, `inLocative`, `inVocative`. All of them are async and return a Promise.
- Input: `{ gender, givenName?, patronymicName?, familyName? }`. `gender` is required and is `"masculine"` or `"feminine"` (`shevchenko.GrammaticalGender.MASCULINE` / `FEMININE` in TypeScript). At least one name field is required. Names must be in Ukrainian and in the nominative case.
- Output: the same object without `gender`, with each name field declined.
- `detectGender({ givenName?, patronymicName?, familyName? })` is async and returns a Promise that resolves to `"masculine"`, `"feminine"` or `null` if the gender cannot be detected.
- Invalid input throws `InputValidationError`.

Example:

```js
import * as shevchenko from 'shevchenko';

const vocative = await shevchenko.inVocative({
  gender: 'masculine',
  givenName: 'Тарас',
  patronymicName: 'Григорович',
  familyName: 'Шевченко',
});
// { givenName: 'Тарасе', patronymicName: 'Григоровичу', familyName: 'Шевченку' }
```

## Online tool

- [Відмінювання ПІБ онлайн](https://shevchenko-js.tooleks.com/): відмінювання прізвищ, імен та по батькові онлайн за всіма відмінками
- [Online declension in English](https://shevchenko-js.tooleks.com/en-US/): the same tool with an English interface
- [Відмінювання військових звань і посад](https://shevchenko-js.tooleks.com/military/): відмінювання військових звань і посад разом із прізвищем, ім'ям та по батькові онлайн
- [Military ranks and appointments in English](https://shevchenko-js.tooleks.com/en-US/military/): the same tool with an English interface

## Docs

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tooleks/shevchenko-js/main/README.md): installation, import options and usage examples
- [API specification](https://shevchenko-js.tooleks.com/api-spec/): full reference of functions, types and parameters
- [HTTP API](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tooleks/shevchenko-js/main/docker/README.md): Docker image `tooleks/shevchenko` that runs the library as a web service with `POST /{case}` and `POST /gender` endpoints
- [Military extension](https://github.com/tooleks/shevchenko-ext-military): `shevchenko-ext-military` package that adds declension of military ranks and appointments, registered with `shevchenko.registerExtension(militaryExtension)`
